title: Preparing for the 2026 Farmers Insurance Open
description:
Behind the scenes at Torrey Pines!⛳ Our dedicated ground maintenance team is working hard to prepare the course for the 2026 Farmers Insurance Open, where top golfers in the world will compete.

Every detail counts, and our City employees are doing everything to make sure the course is in top shape. 

Join us Thursday, Jan. 29 to Sunday, Feb. 1! For more information, visit farmersinsuranceopen.com
